title: The Impact of Shear on Disk Galaxy Star Formation Rates
question: Does the star formation efficiency per orbital time depend on orbital shear (beta) as predicted by the shear-driven GMC collision model, eps_orb proportional to (1-0.7 beta)?

data.angular_resolution: azimuthal averages in 500 pc-wide radial bins

what.value: Machine-readable tables of Sigma_SFR, Sigma_mol, Sigma_atom, Omega, beta in 500 pc radial bins

evidence.quote: We extract these measurements from machine-readable tables (cite: Sun_etal_2022)

evidence.loc: 4.2 Impact of a Bar on Star Formation
evidence.quote: annuli that do and do not overlap with the footprint of a stellar bar, (cite: Querejeta_etal_2021)

what.value: Rotation curves and v_circ from CO kinematics

evidence.quote: $v_\mathrm{circ}$ and $\beta$ were based on CO kinematics (cite: Lang_etal_2020)

recipe.method: Take Sigma_SFR, Sigma_gas, Sigma_mol, Omega, beta from published tables; compute eps_orb = Sigma_SFR t_orb / Sigma_gas

recipe.goal: Bin by beta and fit shear law
recipe.method: Median eps_orb in beta bins of width 0.05, excluding bins with <10 points; fit eps_orb0(1-alpha_CC beta) for beta<=0.5
Split annuli by overlap with bar footprint; compare median eps_orb and refit
